brand.name: Quillfern Plant Co.
brand.bio: Houseplants that survive beginners. Monthly care kits + a plant-care chat. DM RESCUE for the free checklist.
content_observed: Repotting and propagation reels with ASMR audio
Aesthetic shelf tours with no mention of the subscription
Occasional carousels on watering and light
brand.funnel_observed: Reels -> profile -> link in bio -> subscription page; DM keyword RESCUE sends a free care checklist
brand.offer: Monthly beginner care-kit subscription (fictional price EUR 24/month): one easy plant, soil mix and access to a plant-care chat

goal: Increase trial subscriptions coming from Instagram without losing the reach of repotting reels
constraints: keep the ASMR repotting format that drives reach
warm, reassuring tone; never shame beginners
never promise that a plant cannot die or any guaranteed result
do not sound like generic AI copy
analysis_hypotheses: Rescue transformations drive reach but rarely bridge to the subscription.
Subscriber testimonials are nearly absent from the feed.
The feed over-indexes on aesthetic top-of-funnel content versus care education.
